readiness.note_zh: 站外可观测、且站方可修的部分。这是本量表打分的对象，也是服务能承诺的范围。

citation.note_zh: 用行业真实问题在主流 AI 搜索实测被引用情况。结果型指标，单独报告，不并入就绪度——它由就绪度与时间共同决定，且同一问题多次提问结果不同，不可复现。把它并进主分会同时伤害客户与口径可信度。

bands.name: Leading
bands.meaning: Already ahead. The work shifts from building to holding and widening the lead.
bands.meaning_zh: 已建立优势，重点转向维持与扩大

bands.name: Solid
bands.meaning: Foundations are in place. What is left is content depth and brand assets.
bands.meaning_zh: 地基完备，缺口集中在内容深度与品牌资产

bands.name: Growing
bands.meaning: Most of the work has started. What is missing is consistency across the site.
bands.meaning_zh: 主要项目已在做，差的是系统性与一致性

bands.name: Early
bands.meaning: Clear gaps in the basics — most of them are days of work, not quarters.
bands.meaning_zh: 基础项有明显缺口，其中多数可在数人天内补齐

bands.name: Not started
bands.meaning: Nothing has been built for AI retrieval yet. The largest headroom of any band.
bands.meaning_zh: 尚未针对 AI 检索做过建设，提升空间最大

report.order_zh: 首屏的三处缺口按可回收分数排序；门槛项未拿满时永远排第一，因为在爬虫拿不到内容之前，其余各项的改动都不会产生效果。
report.first_screen_zh: 首屏三样：当前分与所处档、距下一档还差几分、以及最大的三处缺口。完整清单必须同时给出，放在首屏之后。
report.each_finding_zh: 每条失分固定三段：为什么重要、当前落在哪一档、上一档要求什么。「怎么修」与工期属于实施层，不在本量表范围内。
report.every_check_zh: 通过的项也要列出来。只列失败项的报告读起来像销售文件。

checks.name: Retrieval crawlers allowed in robots.txt

tiers.condition: robots.txt carries a Disallow that applies to retrieval user-agents
tiers.condition_zh: 对检索类 UA 设了 Disallow

tiers.condition: no explicit Disallow, but no explicit Allow either
tiers.condition_zh: 没有适用于检索 UA 的 Disallow，但也没有任何 Allow 指令
检索 UA 被明确放行——逐个具名 Allow，或 User-agent: * 下有 Allow: / 且无适用的 Disallow

checks.why: The one check where failing makes every other change pointless. If a retrieval crawler is blocked, nothing you do on the page reaches an answer engine.
checks.why_zh: 唯一一条「没做到，后面全部白做」的检查。爬虫被挡住时，站内做得再好也进不了 AI 的答案。
checks.gate_note_zh: 门槛项：计分，同时是封顶条件。任一门槛项**得 0 分**时，**归一化分**封顶 40%（封的是百分比，不是原始分），并在报告首屏置顶为 P0。封顶只在真的拿不到内容时触发——中间档意味着够用但不够好，那是扣分，不是封顶。

checks.name: Reachable to retrieval user-agents
checks.name_zh: 检索 UA 实测可达

tiers.condition_zh: 多数检索 UA 被拦

tiers.condition: some are blocked, or the body differs from what a browser receives
tiers.condition_zh: 1–9 个 UA 返回 200，或正文与浏览器所见不一致

tiers.condition: all 10 retrieval user-agents return 200 with matching content
tiers.condition_zh: 10 个 UA 均 200，且正文与浏览器所见一致

checks.why: Allowing a crawler in robots.txt is not the same as serving it. CDNs and WAFs block by user-agent, and only a live request shows it.
checks.why_zh: robots.txt 写了放行不等于真拿得到——CDN 与 WAF 常按 UA 拦截，这一层只有实测看得见。「内容一致」指正文文本一致，按去掉空白后的正文比对，不按原始字节——CSRF token、nonce、时间戳的差异不算不一致。
checks.gate_note_zh: 门槛项：计分，同时是封顶条件。任一门槛项**得 0 分**时，**归一化分**封顶 40%（封的是百分比，不是原始分），并在报告首屏置顶为 P0。封顶只在真的拿不到内容时触发——中间档意味着够用但不够好，那是扣分，不是封顶。

checks.name: Main content server-rendered

tiers.condition: body copy exists only after JavaScript runs
tiers.condition_zh: 正文完全依赖 JS 渲染

tiers.condition: present in the HTML response on every sampled page
tiers.condition_zh: 8 页正文均在 HTML 响应中

checks.why: Most retrieval crawlers do not execute JavaScript. Content that appears only in a browser does not exist as far as an answer engine is concerned.
checks.why_zh: 多数检索爬虫不执行 JS。正文只在浏览器里出现，等于对 AI 不存在。
checks.gate_note_zh: 门槛项：计分，同时是封顶条件。任一门槛项**得 0 分**时，**归一化分**封顶 40%（封的是百分比，不是原始分），并在报告首屏置顶为 P0。封顶只在真的拿不到内容时触发——中间档意味着够用但不够好，那是扣分，不是封顶。

checks.name: Sitemap discoverable and fresh

tiers.condition: cannot be discovered, or does not return 200

tiers.condition_zh: 且多数 URL 带 lastmod

checks.why: Retrieval side finds new pages through the sitemap; without lastmod it cannot tell which pages are worth fetching again. A path declared in robots.txt takes precedence over the conventional one.
checks.why_zh: 检索侧靠 sitemap 发现新页；没有 lastmod 就无法判断哪些内容值得重抓。robots.txt 中声明的路径优先于约定路径。

checks.name: llms.txt present and structured

tiers.condition: and has 2+ topic sections that contain links
tiers.condition_zh: 且有 2 个以上含链接的主题分节

checks.why: The only place you get to tell the retrieval side directly who you are and which pages matter. It costs almost nothing.
checks.why_zh: 你唯一能直接告诉检索侧「我是谁、该看哪几页」的地方，成本极低。

checks.name: Organization + WebSite sitewide

tiers.condition: both present with name, url and logo
and the logo resolves, with sameAs declared
tiers.condition_zh: 且 logo 可解析、含 sameAs

checks.why: This is how an engine decides which company you are. Without it your brand name can be attributed to someone else who shares it.
checks.why_zh: AI 判断「你是哪家公司」的第一依据。缺了它，品牌名可能被归给同名的别人。

checks.name: BreadcrumbList on nested pages
checks.why: Tells the retrieval side where a page sits in the site — whether it is an overview or a detail. Excluded if the site has no hierarchy.
checks.why_zh: 让检索侧理解这一页在站内的位置，判断它是概览还是细节。全站无层级则退出分母。

checks.name: Page-type schema where applicable

tiers.condition: present across applicable page types with real field values
tiers.condition_zh: 全部适用页型都有，且字段真实

checks.why: Product + Offer for commerce, HowTo for docs, FAQPage for Q&A. Excluded entirely if the site has no matching page type.
checks.why_zh: 电商 Product+Offer、文档 HowTo、问答 FAQPage。站点无对应页型则整项退出分母。

checks.name: Self-contained answer passages
checks.why: An engine quotes a passage that stands on its own. Without one, good content still only gets summarised, never cited.
checks.why_zh: AI 引用的是「一段能独立成立的话」。没有这样的段落，再好的内容也只会被概括，不会被引用。

checks.name: Headings match how people ask

tiers.condition: headings are mostly keyword strings or brand labels
tiers.condition_zh: 标题多为关键词串或品牌标签

tiers.condition: a few headings read like a question someone would ask

checks.why: People ask assistants in natural language. Questions (What is X?), tasks (Accept a payment) and explanations (How Connect works) all count; only keyword strings and brand labels do not.
checks.why_zh: 用户向助手提问用的是自然语言。问句、任务句（Accept a payment）、说明句（How X works）都算；纯关键词串不算。

checks.name: Freshness signal present

tiers.condition: no date in the page or in structured data
tiers.condition_zh: 页面与结构化数据均无日期

tiers.condition: some pages carry a visible date or datePublished
most pages do, and dateModified agrees with the visible date
tiers.condition_zh: 6 页及以上有，且与 dateModified 一致

checks.why: Engines prefer content whose currency they can confirm. A schema date or a date a reader can see — either one qualifies.
checks.why_zh: AI 倾向引用能确认时效的内容。schema 日期或页面可见日期，二者其一即可。

checks.name: Statistics carry a source

tiers.condition: figures and claims carry no source
most are attributed and the source is clickable and checkable
tiers.condition_zh: 4 处及以上标注，且来源可点击可核实

checks.why: An attributed number is quoted far more readily than a bare one — it gives the citing side something to stand on.
checks.why_zh: 带出处的数字被引用概率显著高于裸数字——它让引用方有据可依。

checks.name: Named, verifiable authorship

tiers.condition: no byline, or the byline is the organisation
and the name links to a verifiable identity page
tiers.condition_zh: 姓名链向可核实的身份页

checks.why: A byline that resolves to a person is the core of E-E-A-T. An on-site author page or the person's own homepage both qualify — an on-site bio is not required.
checks.why_zh: 署名到人是 E-E-A-T 的核心。身份页在站内或本人主页均可，不强制站内 bio。

checks.name: Third-party listings
checks.why: Directories, review platforms and app stores are where an engine cross-checks that you exist.
checks.why_zh: 行业目录、评测平台、应用市场是 AI 交叉验证你存在的地方。

checks.name: Independent mentions
checks.why: Saying you are good on your own channels is not evidence. Someone else saying it is.
checks.why_zh: 自有渠道说自己好不构成证据，独立提及才构成。

checks.name: Knowledge-graph entity

tiers.condition: an entry exists in Wikidata, Wikipedia, Baidu Baike or similar
tiers.condition_zh: 维基数据／维基百科／百度百科等有对应实体

checks.why: A knowledge-base entry is the single strongest signal an engine has for confirming an entity's identity.
checks.why_zh: 知识库条目是 AI 确认实体身份最强的单一信号。

checks.name: sameAs complete and resolving

tiers.condition: not declared, or most do not resolve
tiers.condition_zh: 未声明，或多数不可解析

tiers.condition: all resolve and belong to the brand
tiers.condition_zh: 全部可解析且确为本品牌

checks.why: sameAs binds the site to its accounts as one entity. Declaring none scores 0 — it does not leave the denominator.
checks.why_zh: sameAs 把官网与各平台账号绑成同一实体。未声明记 0 分，不退出分母。

checks.name: Video and multimodal presence

tiers.condition: a channel exists but content is sparse
sustained output, with VideoObject on site
tiers.condition_zh: 持续输出且站内带 VideoObject

checks.why: Multimodal content reaches answers through a different path than text. It adds, it does not substitute.
checks.why_zh: 多模态内容进入 AI 答案的通道与文本不同，是增量而非替代。

checks.name: Content shaped for extraction

tiers.condition: subheadings present but paragraphs run long
subheadings, lists and tables with paragraphs of workable length
tiers.condition_zh: 小标题、列表、表格齐备，段落适中

checks.why: The same content is cited more often when a block of it can be lifted out whole.
checks.why_zh: 同样的内容，能被整块摘出来的形态被引用率更高。

checks.name: Coverage of the questions people ask
checks.why: Ten questions people in this industry actually ask, against pages that answer them head-on. The gaps are the editorial calendar.
checks.why_zh: 针对该行业 10 个高频真实问题，站内是否有页面正面回答。缺口清单直接就是选题表。

checks.name: Chinese engine readiness

tiers.condition: crawling blocked, or filing information absent
tiers.condition_zh: 抓取受阻或备案信息缺失

tiers.condition: crawlable with ICP filing and entity information complete
tiers.condition_zh: 可抓取且备案与主体信息齐备

checks.why: Applies when the site addresses the Chinese market; excluded entirely when it does not.
checks.why_zh: 面向中文市场时适用；不面向中文市场则整项退出分母。

checks.name: llms-full.txt
checks.pass: A single aggregated full-text file. A non-root path is allowed as long as it is discoverable from llms.txt or robots.txt.
checks.pass_zh: 提供全文聚合文件；允许非根路径，但需可从 llms.txt 或 robots.txt 发现
checks.note_zh: 不进分母，只加分。这些约定采纳率仍很低，做了是领先，没做不扣分。

checks.name: ai.txt
checks.pass_zh: 声明 AI 使用政策
checks.note_zh: 不进分母，只加分。这些约定采纳率仍很低，做了是领先，没做不扣分。

checks.name: GEO link tags
checks.pass: Declares retrieval-facing link relations in the head.
checks.pass_zh: 在 head 声明面向 AI 检索的 link 关系
checks.note_zh: 不进分母，只加分。这些约定采纳率仍很低，做了是领先，没做不扣分。

checks.name: speakable markup
checks.pass: Marks the region a voice assistant should read aloud.
checks.pass_zh: 为语音助手标注可朗读区域
checks.note_zh: 不进分母，只加分。这些约定采纳率仍很低，做了是领先，没做不扣分。
